items.source: Names may be used to determine the target cache(s), to be resolved via the configured cacheResolver() which typically delegates to CacheManager.getCache(String). For further details see Cacheable.cacheNames().
items.translation: 名称可用于确定目标缓存，这些缓存将通过配置的cacheResolver()进行解析，该解析器通常委托给CacheManager.getCache(String)。有关详细信息，请参阅Cacheable.cacheNames()。

items.source: If no resolver and no cache manager are set at the operation level, and no cache resolver is set via cacheResolver(), this one is used instead of the default.
items.translation: 如果操作级别未设置解析器和缓存管理器，且未通过cacheResolver()设置缓存解析器，则使用此解析器而不是默认值。

items.source: Intended to be used when no other attributes are needed, for example: @CacheConfig("books").
items.translation: 打算在不需要其他属性时使用，例如： @CacheConfig("books")。

items.source:
When this annotation is present on a given class, it provides a set
of default settings for any cache operation defined in that class.
items.translation: 当此注解存在于某个类上时，它为该类中定义的任意缓存操作提供一组默认设置。

items.source: If none is set at the operation level, these are used instead of the default.
items.translation: 如果未在操作级别设置，则使用这些值而不是默认值。

items.source: If none is set at the operation level, this one is used instead of the default.
items.translation: 如果未在操作级别设置，则使用此值代替默认值。

items.source:
The key generator is mutually exclusive with the use of a custom key. When such key is
defined for the operation, the value of this key generator is ignored.
items.translation: 密钥生成器与使用自定义密钥互斥。当为该操作定义了此类密钥时，此密钥生成器的值将被忽略。

items.source:
If no resolver and no cache manager are set at the operation level, this one is used
instead of the default.
items.translation: 如果未在操作级别设置解析器和缓存管理器，则使用此配置项替代默认值。

items.source: The bean name of the custom CacheResolver to use.
items.translation: 要使用的自定义CacheResolver的 bean 名称。

items.source: The bean name of the default KeyGenerator to use for the class.
items.translation: 用于该类的默认 `KeyGenerator` 的 Bean 名称。

items.source: The bean name of the custom CacheManager to use to create a default CacheResolver if none is set already.
items.translation: 用于在尚未设置的情况下创建默认CacheResolver的自定义CacheManager的 bean 名称。

items.source:
Names of the default caches to consider for caching operations defined
in the annotated class.
items.translation: 用于考虑缓存由注解类中定义的缓存操作的默认缓存名称。
